expectations.text: Hero headline leads with the transformation (3 weeks to 4 days) or business outcome ($2M ARR)
expectations.evidence: H1 reads 'Nexus Platform' / 'Enterprise Workflow Automation' - leads with project/category name. The subtitle mentions the transformation but it's not in the primary headline. Should lead with '3 weeks to 4 days' or '$2M ARR' transformation.

expectations.text: Mentions leading/mentoring the junior designer as a leadership signal
expectations.evidence: States in Overview: 'As the lead designer...1 Junior Designer' in team composition. Leadership role clearly signaled through title and team reporting structure.

expectations.text: Includes the chatbot pushback story with research-backed reasoning
expectations.evidence: Design Decisions section includes full chatbot pushback story: 'Rejected Conversational UI (Chatbot)' with explanation that 'Research revealed that users explicitly wanted structured, predictable workflows—not conversational interfaces.'

expectations.text: Covers establishing the platform design system
expectations.evidence: Solution section lists 'Design System' as key feature: 'Established comprehensive design system providing consistency, accessibility, and a foundation for future product development.'

expectations.text: Explains the progressive disclosure decision for 200+ field forms
expectations.evidence: Design Decisions section: 'Compliance forms often contain 200+ fields. Rather than overwhelming users with all fields at once, I implemented a progressive disclosure pattern.'

expectations.text: Describes the audit confidence score visualization
expectations.evidence: Design Decisions section dedicated to 'Audit Confidence Score': 'Designed a novel visualization that calculates and displays real-time audit readiness status.'

expectations.text: Includes $2M ARR, NPS 28->67, 15 institutions, 3 weeks->4 days
expectations.evidence: Results section shows: $2M ARR Expansion, NPS Score: 67 (from 28), 15+ Institutions, 75% Time Reduction (3 weeks to 4 days).

expectations.text: Incorporates the user's insight about 'delightful means trustworthy and predictable'
expectations.evidence: Reflection section: 'The Core Insight - In compliance, delightful means trustworthy and predictable, not clever and novel.' Direct quote and elaboration of the insight.

Mostly third-person or passive constructions: 'As the lead designer', 'This project transformed', 'The system's design', 'The feature became'. Limited first-person 'I' statements throughout. Lacks consistent 'I led', 'I designed' ownership language.
Role described as 'Lead Designer' - title conveys seniority without explicit 'senior' claim.
